title: Can’t praise Ashley and the team at Renegade Solar enough
review: Can’t praise Ashley and the team at Renegade Solar enough! Absolutely outstanding from start to finish. They designed and fitted our full 12-panel solar system with batteries, inverters and car charger. They genuinely went above and beyond, nothing was too much trouble and even my daftest questions were answered with patience! No pushy sales, just honest advice, exceptional service and a fantastic price. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them!
